facts.statement: i-D magazine returns to UK newsstands as Gen Z revives interest in print media
facts.support: The article states that i-D magazine is back on shelves due to renewed interest in print magazines driven by Gen Z.

facts.statement: Physical media like fashion magazines are becoming status symbols due to nostalgia
facts.support: The article compares the revival of print magazines to other physical items like vinyl records, indicating a trend toward tangible collectibles.
